name: MINOR IN GEOPHYSICS
title: MINOR IN GEOPHYSICS Faculty of Science - Earth Sciences

sections.heading: MINOR IN GEOPHYSICS
lines: This minor is recommended to Physics and Astronomy, Applied Mathematics, and Computer Science Majors.

Completion of first-year requirements, including 1.0 course from: (Calculus 1000A/B or Calculus 1500A/B or Numerical and Mathematical Methods 1412A/B) and (Applied Mathematics 1201A/B or Calculus 1301A/B or Calculus 1501A/B, or Numerical and Mathematical Methods 1414A/B).

4.0 courses from: Earth Sciences 2123F/G, Earth Sciences 2220A/B, Earth Sciences 2222A/B, Earth Sciences 2281A/B, Earth Sciences 3320A/B, Earth Sciences 3323A/B, Earth Sciences 4321A/B, Earth Sciences 4420A/B, Earth Sciences 4421A/B, Earth Sciences 4423A/B, Earth Sciences 4424A/B, Earth Sciences 4440A/B, the former Earth Sciences 3321A/B, the former Earth Sciences 4425A/B.
